Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

appc 2.99.0.9000

  • Prepare model generation 3 for January 2017 through June 2026 using geomarker 0.2.0, pinned to release commit 373820d0ab8082f856f7bf0f639f3128111d825a.
  • Share geomarker-backed predictor assembly between the committed training-data script and prediction, preserving input location/date order and duplicates.
  • Keep AQS outcome harmonization and the existing GRF training specification.
  • Remove standalone environmental assessment and installation APIs; use geomarker for those functions. Elevation now comes from USGS 3DEP rather than the v2 PRISM source, so the v2 model cannot be reused with these inputs.
  • Record model generation separately from package version, preserve training provenance, and require matching metadata for local v3 model artifacts.
  • Full v3 training and publication are still required. Documentation does not present v2 predictions or performance as results from v3.

Developed by Cole Brokamp, Erika Manning, Qing Duan.
